info.title: Speakr clinic offline-web extension (proposed)
info.description: Additive own-platform contract for PAR-REC-007, R-039 and R-042. Not an implemented Speakr endpoint. Manufacturer interfaces remain unresolved. BT-REC-007 and all web parity gaps remain open.

x-browser-boundary: Browser MediaRecorder and explicit user file open/save only. BYOD has no intentional persistent audio or text. Managed persistence requires a fresh, explicit, encrypted_user_unlock server grant and a verified browser profile. No native recorder, extension, local bridge, secret in browser storage, or cloud ASR. Browser eviction can remove offline drafts.
x-reconnect-semantics: Local draft is UNSENT until the existing ingest APIs return a durable STORED receipt; STORED does not imply submitted, delivered or protected. On reconnect recheck current grant and object rights before each operation. A disconnected request cannot be reported successful. After an ambiguous failure, GET the existing ingest receipt and replay the same idempotency key or chunk sequence and digest; never silently create a second delivery.
x-no-new-command: Live-session parity commands remain online-only; the existing ingest, submit and revision commands handle reconnection. No offline-specific parity command exists in the current catalog.
x-reused-write-guards: Existing browser writes require X-CSRFToken (parity commands use X-CSRF-Token), fresh object/scope permission and current lease where applicable. Idempotency-Key is scoped by actor+operation+aggregate+request hash. Changed payload under a reused key => 409. If-Match on submit/revision protects current server revision; absent => 428, stale => 412. Chunk sequence+SHA256 repeats are safe; changed bytes => 409. Use the existing BeginIngest 128 MiB total, PutChunk 4 MiB per chunk, and FinalizeIngest 128 segment limits. No offline shortcut to release or delivery.

get.summary: Read current managed browser offline permission
get.description: CLINIC_MODE only. Adapter calls src.clinic.offline_policy.offline_capability with the current server-side grant and trusted-ingress VerifiedBrowser; client headers never grant privileges. Discovery omits all previous-* headers. Resume supplies all three stored reference fields; compare them to the verified browser and current grant. Partial reference => 400, missing reference on an identified resume => 428, stale reference => 412. A disabled/revoked grant returns 200 available=false, never a false online delivery receipt. No CSRF on this safe GET; subsequent writes retain their existing CSRF and object policies. No caching or patient content in response or logs. Body 1 KiB maximum.
get.x-required-role-policy: authenticated active user with verified managed_web_offline browser; object permissions rechecked by existing ingest/dictation operations

parameters.name: X-Offline-Previous-Version
parameters.description: Prior server grant revision for resume; all previous-* headers are required together.

parameters.name: X-Offline-Previous-Browser-Id
parameters.description: Original draft browser binding, never a substitute for ingress verification.

parameters.name: X-Offline-Previous-Account-Version
parameters.description: Original draft account/session version; never an authentication credential.

200.description: Current approval or explicit unavailable state
